decisions.reason: Reject this exact current master for directly visible source-feature and note-layout defects: the original has dark, distinct brows over both eyes, while the raw master has a smooth yellow brow area without those visible dark eyebrows. The exact source note has two rows of indistinct markings, while the generated note adds a third row; preserve the actual row/group arrangement without inventing additional lines. Mascot yellow identity/green eyes, swept greying hair, upper-lip moustache with clean chin, dark suit/white shirt/patterned tie, full tilted frame, photographic backing and overlapping paper are present; compact broad lower head meets the adapted collar without a long neck or cream bib. White/cyan sheets show no large visible clothing/backing holes. Raw alpha is not 255 internally: histogram contains 1,047,161 pixels at253 and 39,395 at252 (843 at255), recorded honestly; this statistic is not the art rejection and is not described as a large hole or used to request another generic opacity edit. Opacity compliance needs independent alpha investigation. Correct the missing source brows and the extra note row from the exact source.
